reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the boron-addition strategy from HfMoNbTaTiZr (P12, P18, P29) to NbMoTaW, but provides no new mechanistic insight, alloy-specific justification, or integration with the irradiation literature beyond stating that borides will act as defect sinks. The core idea, mechanism, and predicted outcomes are taken almost verbatim from the earlier work on a different alloy.
